name: Predatory nematodes
description: Nematodes that hunt other soil organisms: all other nematode groups plus protozoa (amoebae and flagellates) and, weakly, bacteria. Functional group pooling all predaceous nematode species, grouped by the source on the basis of their shared diet. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
